I will do this rice the way I know and the way I can afford. Last season I did not put too many bought things because cash is tight, and I will not risk money I do not have, but on rice I will still try to buy some fertilizer if I can get it in time because I have seen it help. I will keep my own seed, use manure from home, depend mostly on rain, and call a few people for hired work when the work is too much for my family.
